findings.observation: The chibi remains unmistakably Seno: a young adult band-5 woman with the same tapered triangular face, small bright eyes, fine straight brows, subtly crooked healed nose, balanced closed mouth, freckles, and calm unsmiling gaze rather than a generic baby or doll face.

The figure keeps Seno lean-to-average and visibly slight through narrow shoulders, compact torso, slim waist, restrained limb mass, and comparatively long-legged posture; no muscle or body-fat inflation is introduced.

Both arms retain source-relative slim upper arms and forearms, narrow wrists, and small natural adult hands; the two empty hands form readable relaxed-ready fists without oversized mitts, duplication, or malformed fingers.

The matte blue-teal color, loose tousled swept front and side silhouette, parting, gathered mass, and offset left braid remain recognizable from the summon with no added ornament or supernatural emission.

The rust-charcoal work shirt, asymmetrical layered apron, repairs, contrasting edges, reinforced trousers, rolled cuffs, and sturdy shoes are preserved, but the summon-visible wooden comb is absent, breaking complete object and accessory continuity.

Original-resolution inspection places the complete top-of-hair-to-chin unit at roughly 29 to 30 percent of top-of-hair-to-lowest-sole standing height, about 3.35 heads total. This misses the frozen 32 to 36 percent gate and the requested 34 to 35 percent aim.
Exactly one coherent subject appears with the full hair mass, head, both empty hands, both trouser legs, and both shoes fully inside generous parchment margins.
The grounded three-quarter stance, staggered sturdy feet, bent elbows, two empty low fists, and clean silhouette read as a weaponless ready-idle at combat-icon scale.

The patched cloth workwear and practical shoes remain ordinary mortal equipment; no weapon, attack, armor upgrade, magic, aura, glow, affinity cue, gem, floating, frame, star, number, UI, text, label, logo, watermark, or supernatural effect appears.
